Screenshot access
Copy Text takes a screenshot first. GNOME asks once whether to allow it, and only while
window is in front.
Accurate recognition
With a cloud model set, it reads the screenshot; otherwise text is read on
this computer (about 15 MB downloads the first time).

Dictate into any app
Speak, and the text is typed at the cursor.
Shortcut
Set by GNOME. Change it in Settings › Apps › Blurt.
